Usage

TokenUsed for
--color-surfaceCards, modals, sidebar header, table head — anything that sits on top
--color-bgPage background, nested code blocks, table row hover
--color-borderCard outlines, table dividers, input borders (resting)
--color-border-strongInput borders (resting/hover), prominent dividers
--color-sidebar-bgSidebar background and other dark structural surfaces
--color-sidebar-hoverSidebar nav item hover background
